summary: Read the host from the authority when java.net.URI leaves it unparsed, convert non-ASCII hosts to ASCII with UTS #46 (ICU4J), and use that one form for destination checks and the redirect; ASCII hosts and the stored URL are unchanged.

files.content:
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<project xmlns="http://maven.apache.org/POM/4.0.0"
         xmlns:xsi="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema-instance"
         xsi:schemaLocation="http://maven.apache.org/POM/4.0.0 https://maven.apache.org/xsd/maven-4.0.0.xsd">
    <modelVersion>4.0.0</modelVersion>

    <parent>
        <groupId>org.springframework.boot</groupId>
        <artifactId>spring-boot-starter-parent</artifactId>
        <version>3.4.5</version>
        <relativePath/>
    </parent>

    <groupId>com.example</groupId>
    <artifactId>url-shortener</artifactId>
    <version>1.0.0-SNAPSHOT</version>
    <name>url-shortener</name>
    <description>URL shortener service: short links, redirects, expiry, token-authorized deletion</description>

    <properties>
        <java.version>17</java.version>
        <bucket4j.version>8.14.0</bucket4j.version>
        <icu4j.version>77.1</icu4j.version>
    </properties>

    <dependencies>
        <dependency>
            <groupId>org.springframework.boot</groupId>
            <artifactId>spring-boot-starter-web</artifactId>
        </dependency>
        <dependency>
            <groupId>org.springframework.boot</groupId>
            <artifactId>spring-boot-starter-validation</artifactId>
        </dependency>
        <dependency>
            <!-- health and metrics on a loopback-only management port (FR14, FR15) -->
            <groupId>org.springframework.boot</groupId>
            <artifactId>spring-boot-starter-actuator</artifactId>
        </dependency>
        <dependency>
            <groupId>org.springframework.boot</groupId>
            <artifactId>spring-boot-starter-data-jpa</artifactId>
        </dependency>
        <dependency>
            <groupId>org.flywaydb</groupId>
            <artifactId>flyway-core</artifactId>
        </dependency>
        <dependency>
            <groupId>com.h2database</groupId>
            <artifactId>h2</artifactId>
            <scope>runtime</scope>
        </dependency>
        <dependency>
            <groupId>com.bucket4j</groupId>
            <artifactId>bucket4j_jdk17-core</artifactId>
            <version>${bucket4j.version}</version>
        </dependency>

        <dependency>
            <!-- UTS #46 (browser-compatible) conversion of internationalized host names to ASCII -->
            <groupId>com.ibm.icu</groupId>
            <artifactId>icu4j</artifactId>
            <version>${icu4j.version}</version>
        </dependency>

        <dependency>
            <groupId>org.springframework.boot</groupId>
            <artifactId>spring-boot-starter-test</artifactId>
            <scope>test</scope>
        </dependency>
    </dependencies>

    <build>
        <plugins>
            <plugin>
                <groupId>org.springframework.boot</groupId>
                <artifactId>spring-boot-maven-plugin</artifactId>
            </plugin>
        </plugins>
    </build>
</project>

decisions.choice: java.net.URI.getHost() is null for internationalized and underscore host names; DestinationPolicy read that as no host
decisions.rationale: Probed against the running service before the run; the regression tests confirm it

decisions.topic: One conversion for check and redirect
decisions.choice: DestinationUrls.toAscii feeds both the destination check and redirectTarget
decisions.rationale: The approved impact plan's key risk: if the two interpreted a host differently, a spelling could bypass the rules or redirect elsewhere. Verified that full-width localhost and 127.0.0.1 forms are refused

decisions.choice: ICU4J 77.1, UTS #46 non-transitional with CheckBidi and CheckJoiners, hyphen checks off
decisions.rationale: Matches browsers (WHATWG URL); java.net.IDN implements IDNA2003, which maps faß.de to fass.de, a different domain

decisions.choice: Conversion only runs for hosts with non-ASCII characters
decisions.rationale: Existing links, the case of ASCII hosts and every existing destination test keep exactly their old behaviour

decisions.choice: Checking the host as written, or redirecting to the URL as entered, each fail 3 regression tests
decisions.rationale: The regression tests guard the fix, not only the original bug
